purpose: Matched-fact reasoner and reuse perturbations within stable, periodic and frequent evidence regimes

provenance.author: Codex implementation
provenance.reviewer: Independent reference calculation (automated, not an external investigator)
provenance.population: Six deliberately constructed engineering task patterns under three evidence-change regimes; not a sample of engineering work.
provenance.sampling: Purposive factorial fixture construction; cadence variants share task patterns and are not independent task-family samples. Expected labels were assigned from the authored true/false/unknown cycle.

specification.scope_description: Assess conjunctive-release-stable in version 2 under the stable evidence-change regime. Public revision events invalidate all observations of earlier revisions.
specification.natural_language_rule: Both the current check and operating assumption must hold.
